## Description {#details}

C++ header file with declarations for the µTest++ reflection utilities.

This header provides the declarations for the reflection utilities used within the µTest++ framework. It defines interfaces for obtaining source location information and extracting type names at compile time, supporting advanced diagnostics and reporting capabilities.

The reflection utilities include a local implementation of <code>source&#95;location</code> for environments lacking C++20 standard support, as well as functions for extracting concise type names using compiler-specific macros such as <code>&#95;&#95;PRETTY&#95;FUNCTION&#95;&#95;</code>. These facilities enable precise identification of code locations and types in test reports, enhancing the clarity and professionalism of diagnostic output.

All definitions reside within the <code><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reflection">micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus::reflection</a></code> namespace, ensuring clear separation from user code and minimising the risk of naming conflicts.

The header files are organised within the <code>include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus</code> folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.

This file is intended solely for internal use within the framework and should not be included directly by user code.

### short&#95;name() {#ab4fa1159ebe60ce5fe073eefbe9a2446}

<MemberDefinition
  prototype={<>const char &#42; micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus::reflection::short&#95;name (const char &#42; name)</>}>
Extract a short type or function name from a fully qualified name.

<ParametersList title="Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="name">The fully qualified name as a C-string.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>

<SectionUser title="Returns">
A pointer to the short name within the input string.
</SectionUser>

This function extracts the short name from a given file path by locating the final folder separator (&#39;/&#39;). If a separator is found, it returns a pointer to the character immediately following it, effectively providing the file or folder name. If no separator is present, the original input string is returned. This utility is useful for reporting concise file or folder names in test output.

### type&#95;name() {#a6580ad54ad22a1d3ab43a1d9d49d1f26}

<MemberDefinition

  prototype={<>std::string&#95;view micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus::reflection::type&#95;name (void)</>}
  labels = {["nodiscard", "constexpr"]}>
Extract the type name from the <code>&#95;&#95;PRETTY&#95;FUNCTION&#95;&#95;</code> macro.

This function template parses the compiler-specific <code>&#95;&#95;PRETTY&#95;FUNCTION&#95;&#95;</code> macro to extract a concise type name for the template parameter <code>T</code>.

The implementation is compiler-dependent and may require adjustment for different toolchains. It is primarily intended for internal use within the µTest++ framework to support improved diagnostics and reporting.


<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="T">The type whose name is to be extracted.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>

</SectionUser>

</SectionUser>
